_comment: Official YouTube channels for the official-video embed pass (official_video_pass.py). ONLY verified channel IDs may be added — resolve the ID from a known video via the YouTube API (videos.list -> snippet.channelId), never guess. The 42 film-studio channels in trailer-channels.json are merged in at load time by official_video_pass.load_official_channels(); do not duplicate them here. Entries here are rights holders (federations / tours / leagues) whose highlights the generic enrich_youtube() search cannot reliably attribute.
_x_handle_rule: x_handle is the rights holder's official X account, used by official_x_candidates() to widen X-embed discovery beyond the social registry. It is a candidate source only — the existing find_best_tweet + verify_tweet gates still decide at apply time.
